verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and calculates cost for each call automatically for supported integrations, with custom pricing for other models. These costs appear in the trace tree and the calls table, so per-request cost visibility is documented. The evidence never shows dashboard views that aggregate cost or tokens by model or over time; it only shows per-call display. Missing for 10: documented dashboards aggregating cost/tokens by model, time-period trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call. Costs appear in the trace tree and in the calls table in the Weave UI.
Weave captures token usage from the API response and applies built-in pricing for the model, with no extra code required.
Add a custom cost with the `add_cost` method. The three required fields are `llm_id`, `prompt_token_cost`, and `completion_token_cost`.
